careful-haiku.why: Almost the same card in the same place, same layout, cream background and dark green button; you have to compare to see the heading is a size smaller, the links lighter and the shadow flatter. Cleanly built with main, a real form, labels tied to inputs and a submit button.
differences: Heading 'Welcome back' a size smaller and sits closer to the FERNWAY label
'Forgot password?' and 'Create an account' links are regular weight, not bold
Card has almost no drop shadow (reference has a soft visible shadow)
Sign in button a darker green shade; spacing slightly tighter throughout
Native checkbox instead of the reference's light rounded checkbox

lazy-haiku.why: Same card in the same spot with all the parts, but the look has drifted: everything is centred, the heading is a serif, there is a bright green stripe across the top and a mint gradient background. Built well enough (main, labels), though the button is type=button rather than a submit.
differences: Brand, heading and subtitle centred instead of left-aligned
Heading in a serif typeface (Georgia, normal weight) instead of bold sans-serif
Thick green accent bar added across the top of the card
Brighter, more saturated green for brand, links and button instead of deep forest green
Mint green gradient page background instead of flat warm off-white
Divider line added above 'New to Fernway?'; button has a glow shadow

careful-haiku.why: Clearly the same card: lavender page, white card, silhouette avatar, name, title, three stats between rules, full-width Follow button. Visible slips: the card sits higher on the page, its corners are much rounder, and the indigo is a darker, duller shade.
differences: Card starts about 40px from the top instead of about 80px, so it sits noticeably higher
Much rounder card corners (28px) than the reference
Avatar and Follow button a darker, duller indigo instead of the vivid violet-blue
Avatar silhouette drawn smaller inside the circle
Card slightly shorter overall; spacing a little tighter

lazy-haiku.why: Same subject and same pieces of text, but a different design: a deep purple gradient page, a gradient banner across the top of the card, an 'MR' initials avatar, uppercase stat labels, a pill button and an extra line of text nobody asked for. Built with plain divs, no main landmark.
differences: Dark purple gradient page background instead of pale lavender
Purple gradient banner added across the top of the card
Avatar is serif 'MR' initials overlapping the banner instead of a person silhouette
Extra visible line 'Profile in the people directory of a design community app' under the button
Stat labels uppercase with vertical dividers between columns; pill-shaped purple button
Purple colour family instead of indigo/blue-violet; card narrower (360px)
No main landmark; plain div structure

careful-openai.why: Same page top to bottom: white nav bar, centred hero with blue button, three white feature cards, dark footer. Differences are of degree: the headline is noticeably smaller, the subtitle wraps to two lines, and the content column is a little narrower. Cleanly built with header, nav, main, sections, articles and footer.
differences: Hero headline clearly smaller (48px vs about 60px), so the hero feels less bold
Subtitle constrained to a narrower width and wraps onto two lines
Content column narrower: logo, nav and cards inset about 24px further from the edges
Feature card headings and nav text a size smaller, nav text greyer
Footer a slightly bluer navy and a little taller

lazy-openai.why: Same text and same overall sections, but a different page: the hero is left-aligned in two columns with a made-up inbox illustration, the colours are teal-green rather than blue, the cards gain icons, and the dark footer becomes a light one. Structurally sound HTML, but it is not the reference's look.
differences: Hero left-aligned in two columns instead of centred, with the headline wrapping to two lines
Decorative inbox illustration added on the right that the reference does not have
Teal/green colour family (button, headings) instead of blue button and near-black text
Footer light with a thin rule instead of a dark navy band
Icon tiles added above each feature card heading; logo mark added beside 'Harbor'
Nav bar has no white band; background is warm off-white throughout
